title: task
description: A backlog task file (products/<slug>/backlog/T-xxxx.yaml). Only fields the dispatcher reads are listed; others are allowed.

plan.description: Marketer: the deliverable is products/<slug>/marketing-plan.md (a week of slots per channel), not a post; the task is accepted by that file.

repo_only.description: The deliverable is not served publicly (code, tests, docs). The reviewer runs in a read-only checkout of released_sha with Read/Glob/Grep, python3 -m unittest, python3 -m pytest -q, git log -1 and team-fetch.
